records.name: Eye Beam
records.character_source: Android 16 and customizable partner skillset documented by current references
records.skill_description: A controllable Ki Blast Super that fires three small eye beams while the user moves forward.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material classifies Eye Beam as a controllable, mid-range, three-hit projectile with re-stand properties. Directional input can move the user and immediately activate the attack. The attack is distinct from Lord Slug's Darkness Eye Beam and other eye-beam variants.
